reference_policy: unchanged independently propagated original-input global reference

method.gate: unchanged full-vector L20 S18 original-input binary64-v1
method.interval: all signed int64 Q24 I[62] projecting into the passing FP16 interval
method.cells: exact rational midpoint bounds; ties to even; inclusive integer endpoints
method.candidates: both Q24 endpoints of every passing input FP16 RNE cell
method.state: copy I/Z/H; change only I[62]; preserve all Z; recompute only H[62] by RNE16
method.coverage: input cells only; not an exhaustive L21 search or a minimality proof

arithmetic: Native S16 RTZ; signed int64 Q24 residual I/Z with RNE16 H. Official G128 asymmetric packed INT4 qweight/qzeros, native GEMM nibble order, no qzero plus-one, FP16 scales, operator boundaries and own P0 KV. Q24 residual state is wider than FP16.
authentication: Authenticate the reviewed e2612f3b804d execute-r2 stdout by its full byte digest, not the earlier preflight. Preserve INCONCLUSIVE/L20_GLOBAL_GATE_BOUNDARY after 43 native L21 invocations and 44 samples; not exhaustion. Bind its compiled sources, contract, origins and every authenticated input to this worktree. Reuse frozen ancestor state/operand/KV/reference checks without executing their tests or native layers. Verify frozen L20 output equals L21 input, the original-input reference extension, baseline L21 reports and every frozen full-vector L20 sample gate. Rebind all source/contract/input bytes at completion.
numerical_definition: For unchanged exact binary64 r[62], q is the original nearest finite FP16 representation error. Passing words are precisely those in the closed real interval [r-q-1/8,r+q+1/8]. Compute each word's rational RNE midpoints and inclusive Q24 integer endpoints, excluding midpoint ties for odd significands. Their contiguous union is the exact interval, with signed deltas measured from the frozen I[62], not rounded H. No inherited geometric-search radius clips this mathematical interval. This bounded implementation supports positive interior references and rejects other domains rather than substituting a reference or approximating an endpoint.
full_vector_proof: The authenticated frozen parent must pass all 896 coordinates of L20 S18. Preserve every other I/Z/H coordinate and all zero-sign tags. Verify both integer endpoints of every passing input cell against the unchanged full-vector gate. Integers immediately below and above the complete interval must fail only coordinate 62. Exact ordered FP16 cell coverage plus fixed passing other coordinates establishes the full interval, not just sampled endpoints.
candidate_boundary: Report both endpoints of each input FP16/RNE cell and a separate zero-delta baseline control; do not deduplicate equal H. These are a finite prospective candidate set, not exhaustive native L21 coverage. Native L21 residual arithmetic can depend on I within a single H cell, including downstream S12 rounding. No monotonicity, L21 pass, native input threshold, minimality, execution authorization, state publication, successor or policy admission follows.
validation: Compile actual repository diagnostic and focused test sources in memory, parse this contract, and genuinely collect and execute exactly 20 new focused tests once with zero failures/errors/skips. Assert and record all candidate/test origins, including tests.test_q24_s16_toward_zero_l3_l8_v1 inside the isolated repository. Import upstream tests for origin binding only; never execute the accepted 19 tests or any upstream suite. Authenticate and compute the interval once under native/external-execution/publication guards. JSON result on stdout; test diagnostics on stderr; no files or caches created.

No native L0-L8 replay or L9+ execution, RTL, GPU, FPGA, hardware, simulation, synthesis, PPA, new-token, strict-FP16-state W4A16 or full-model PASS.
